Elaine (CS): Quick capture from today’s onboarding with Park & Co — they surfaced a few asks I want captured here:
Jordan (PM): Great, paste the asks and any exact wording/impact they gave.
Elaine (CS): 1) Per-route monthly cost breakdown for finance/chargebacks — 'token-level counts are too blunt for us.' 2) Ability to toggle cheaper quantized model fallback per route. 3) Bulk export of embeddings & CSV export by workspace.
Maya (CS): Also noted they are managing prompt templates in a spreadsheet today — pain point during onboarding.
Ravi (Eng): For per-route cost: backend emits per-token by model; mapping route->model exists in many cases. Console UI is the main piece.
Jordan (PM): Sounds like a medium-effort feature with high customer-visible impact (billing). If they're at renewal, that bumps priority.
Elaine (CS): FYI Park & Co renewal is Aug. Finance needs the report for internal chargebacks — this is a blocker to getting legal signoff for expanded seats.
Nadia (Design): Quick idea: surface a 'Billing at a glance' card on onboarding -> monthly cost per route + export button. Keep first iteration simple.
Jordan (PM): Actionable requirements (draft): (a) per-route monthly totals, (b) CSV export, (c) link from route to model settings so customers can change model/variant.
Ravi (Eng): Estimate: ~3 dev-weeks backend + Console changes. Export and UI toggles included. Need to check telemetry for all legacy routes.
Elaine (CS): They also asked: 'Can we prefer a cheaper quantized fallback for non-critical routes?' Their ML infra team wants cost controls.
Ravi (Eng): Fallback toggle feasible but introduces quality/regression risk. Recommend A/B behind a flag + an eval set to measure drift. Add ~2w for eval harness.
Maya (CS): For prioritization score: Impact = High (renewal + potential upsell), Effort = Medium-High, Urgency = High (renewal timeline).
Jordan (PM): I'll create a ticket and put this into the triage board. Elaine, please attach Park & Co's spreadsheet and any screenshots.
Elaine (CS): Done — uploaded to Drive and linked in the ticket: https://drive.example/parkco-onboard.xlsx :thumbsup:
AutoBot (Zendesk): New ticket created: CS-4821 'Per-route cost view and export' by Jordan (PM).
Ravi (Eng): One clarifying Q — should the initial rollout be Hosted-only or include Dedicated/Private?
Elaine (CS): Park & Co is Hosted, but they asked for an on-prem pattern. They'd prefer both if not too slow.
Jordan (PM): Note: we should scope Hosted GA first, then Dedicated as a follow-up if telemetry and infra mapping are consistent. I'll note that in the ticket.
Elaine (CS): Also capturing a small UX ask: allow saving prompt templates per workspace so onboarding isn't manual. Lower effort and high usability impact.
Nadia (Design): I'll mock a simple 'Saved prompts' panel for the dashboard—low fidelity by next week.
Jordan (PM): Thanks all. I'll summarize in the weekly customer-asks digest and link CS-4821.
Elaine (CS): Thanks team, keeping this thread as the single source for Park & Co asks. :wave:
